environment: Episode 04 T-A10, NHAC-3 take1 113 s at 108 BPM
symptom: loop_extend hung for minutes on one file (two others finished in < 1 s).
root_cause: Envelope slices were taken with integer-divided start/end indices so the candidate slice was one frame shorter than the reference; the search broke on its first iteration, returned t == a, and the extension loop appended an empty segment forever. Killing it by matching 'loop_extend' in Win32_Process command lines also killed the sibling bash wrappers whose command text contained the word.
fix_or_workaround: Fixed-length slices (length = w // hop) and a guard that raises when no loop point lies after the intro; rerun finished in 0.5 s (loop point 94.094 s, score 0.747). Kill by python PID only.
prevention: Compare arrays by a fixed element count, never by two independent integer divisions; every search loop must raise instead of returning its initial sentinel; process kills must match the executable, not a substring of the command line.
verification: scratch loop.json for NHAC-3 and receipts/MUSIC-STATUS.json NHAC-3 loop_extension.
